summary: Comprehensive Sector & Stock Universe Upgrade Plan expanding the Sector Rotation Engine to 62 high-signal institutional clusters (~410 NSE/BSE constituents), incorporating all new-age platforms (Eternal, Swiggy, Nykaa, FirstCry, Paytm, Policybazaar), newly listed IPOs and thematic pure-plays (Milky Mist, Dodla, Hatsun, Heritage, Netweb, Anant Raj, VA Tech Wabag, Gravita, Ola Electric, Premier Energies, Waaree), and deepening existing clusters to 6–10 liquid constituents per basket with an Equal-Weight vs. Market-Cap Weight toggle.
